rules: Assessment applies only to the named deployment, configuration, permissions, tools, and execution path.
Unknown or missing checks remain explicit and cannot be converted to pass.
Counts, corpus size, successful demonstrations, or aggregate BackBond Score cannot establish rate, activation, or claim entitlement.
Report-only, fixture-only, imported, synthetic-only, transport-invalid, and unexecuted tests cannot be represented as live executed passes.

task_protection.historical_rights_rule: A later outage, disconnection, cancellation, or expiry stops new confirmations as applicable but does not erase a previously confirmed obligation or claim access under its governing terms.

claim_entitlement.intake_rule: Accept notice when evidence is incomplete or an adapter missed an event; request information or route to review instead of denying at intake.
claim_entitlement.mandate_deviation_rule: Wrong amount, SKU, date, recipient, or execution count may be the mistake under review. Deviation from the mandate is not by itself a denial reason.

covered_event_candidates.description: The agent executes a purchase with a material amount, currency, SKU, quantity, date, merchant, recipient, or permitted-substitution mismatch against the registered eligible mandate.
The agent or execution path performs more completed purchases than the immutable mandate and authorization permit.
candidate_when: provider_or independently reconciled records show excess execution
duplicate is not only a replayed observation
customer has residual financial loss after refunds or reversals

reservation_rules: Reserve customer and cohort exposure atomically before task protection confirmation.
A repeated request with the same idempotency key and body digest returns the same authoritative decision and cannot allocate twice.
Reuse of an idempotency key with changed content is a conflict.
Concurrent reservations cannot oversubscribe customer or cohort caps.
A task amount or configured benefit limit is not an incurred claim amount.
outstanding_tail_rules: Do not release all exposure merely because execution appears successful.
Retain outstanding exposure through the configured discovery, runoff, and claim-reporting periods.
Later merchant refunds, reversals, or chargebacks are recorded as recoveries and do not rewrite prior entries.
Disconnection, expiry, cancellation, or stop-new-business preserves historical ledger entries and claim access.

unknown_policy: No callback is not proof of no action.
Missing events cannot become successful observations.
Agent-provided or uploaded receipts cannot impersonate verified provider events.
Late evidence may support a claim under a prior valid effective period but cannot create retroactive enrollment.

scenario_truth_table.required_system_result: Join mandate, authorization, protection confirmation, order, and payment without duplicate allocation.
Show requested, approved, and executed values side by side; do not deny merely because the agent deviated.
Return one authoritative result and preserve replay evidence.
Distinguish a real duplicate purchase from event replay and route it as a claim candidate.
Remain unknown, reconcile independently, and never infer success or non-execution.
Reject authorization while preserving any later unauthorized execution as incident evidence.
Create a new mandate version and require new authorization.
Confirm only reservations that fit both customer and cohort caps.
Prevent double recovery according to governing terms.
Block new eligibility where applicable while preserving historical rights and claim access.
Stop new business for the affected cohort without disabling claims or settlement.

existing_test_execution_classification.conclusion: No existing case is credited here as executed against a supported consumer deployment. Runtime execution, applicability, retained evidence, and deployment fingerprint must be verified before an eligibility result is assigned.

stage_c_unsatisfied_requirements.requirement: Select the launch protection path or otherwise approve the legal structure.
Approve initial jurisdiction, customer legal role, backing instrument, disclosures, consent, cancellation, reporting, retention, covered events, exclusions, and claim deadlines.
Provide actual backing and authority references, accepted perils and terms, customer and cohort limits, aggregate, runoff, activation requirements, and funding.
Verify supported account access, APIs or event sources, permitted data, version visibility, control boundary, and a named deployment fingerprint.
Run and retain applicable cases against the named supported deployment; classify every selected case and preserve unknown and missing checks.
Name authorized reviewers and payment approvers; verify recipient controls, reserve and recovery treatment, appeal process, settlement provider, and servicing capacity.
Fund and configure customer, task, cohort, aggregate, runoff, outstanding exposure, claim reserve, recovery, and referral subsidy controls.
Approve offer version, any paid price, subsidy allocation, qualifying event, maximum rewards, expiry, and permitted marketing language.
Verify environment, keys, access reviews, incident ownership, backups and restore, durable jobs and outbox, support routes, and group stop-new-business controls.
Issue authoritative activation receipts and switch only qualifying consumers from observation to active protection within the funded and supportable cohort cap.
